paths.title: Doomguard Marauder
paths.description: Fight as though every exchange should leave something broken, tearing through resistances and opening gaps in enemy armor at the cost of your own protection. Spending an action point unleashes a particularly destructive turn, while critical hits restore some of your health and missed melee strikes help you find your mark on the next attempt. You thrive on relentless pressure, leaving wounds that keep bleeding and make your follow-up attacks harder to escape.

paths.title: Draeven Marauder
paths.description: A spear in your hands is a weapon of pursuit, pinning enemies in place and drawing them out of position as you slip around the battlefield. Frequent critical hits reward your precision, and a well-placed strike against a bloodied foe can lead straight into an attack against another enemy. With shifts to set up an action point assault or carry you away from a fallen opponent, you are always looking for the next opening.

paths.title: Dreadnought
paths.description: Plant yourself in the thick of the fighting and keep advancing when wounds and afflictions would stop another warrior. A deeper reserve of health lets you endure punishment and even pay in blood to shake off lingering effects, while bursts of damage resistance help you weather the enemy's answer. Your attacks carry you forward with short shifts and invigorating blows, leaving battered enemies displaced or dazed in your wake.

paths.title: Gladiator Champion
paths.description: Draw enemies into a close, ugly brawl where hurting one can hurt the others and slipping away becomes increasingly difficult. Your attacks arrange the melee in your allies' favor, and your finishing stance can leave nearby enemies rooted in place as you cut into a bloodied opponent. Being bloodied yourself only sharpens the contest, giving you a stronger action point attack and the footwork to turn an enemy's hit into a new opening.

paths.title: Glorious Myrmidon
paths.description: Move with an athlete's freedom even in chainmail or scale, closing the distance with a charge that can send an enemy sprawling whether the blow lands or not. A kill gives you a chance to catch your breath with second wind, while spending an action point lets you reposition and attack with greater confidence. As your prowess grows, greater speed and a powerful battle stance help you press the attack, stand your ground, and make ignoring your challenge a costly gamble.

paths.title: Iron Vanguard
paths.description: Take ground by force, driving enemies backward and hammering them to the floor while your allies advance behind you. With experience, those pushes and knockdowns become a source of damage in their own right, making Constitution as useful for breaking the enemy line as enduring it. Each kill restores a little health, and your action point defenses and last-moment surge of action help you hold on when the battle turns against you.

paths.title: Kensei
paths.description: Choose a melee weapon and master it until every cut, thrust, or crushing blow lands with exceptional precision and force. That commitment rewards you with lasting accuracy and damage, backed by the option to spend an action point correcting a crucial roll and a parry that softens a punishing hit. At your most fluid, you pass between several enemies in a single sequence, leaving each struck foe on the ground and unable to move.

paths.title: Pit Fighter
paths.description: Win the close fight with hard-earned toughness and the sort of dirty tricks that make every opening hurt. Your armor serves you better, your action point turns hit harder, and Wisdom eventually adds bite to your Fighter and Pit Fighter weapon attacks. A dazing follow-up jab and vicious payback keep opponents under pressure, while a brutal finish against a wounded foe can send the rest scrambling away.

paths.title: Polearm Master
paths.description: Make the space around your reach weapon dangerous, dragging enemies out of position and shoving them farther than they expect. Your daily stance lets you punish openings with opportunity attacks across your weapon's reach, and later even a marked enemy two squares away must think twice before shifting or attacking an ally. Long lunges, sweeping blows, and forceful slides let you dictate where the fight happens before an enemy ever reaches your side.

paths.title: Rampaging Brute
paths.description: Pick a target beyond the enemy line and charge straight through the bodies in your way. Foes that catch you with opportunity attacks can end up on their backs, while your own attacks scatter enemies or turn your arrival into a sweeping blow against the surrounding crowd. Spending an action point gives a charge extra force, and bringing one enemy down can send you thundering straight toward the next.

paths.title: Shield Adept
paths.description: Keep your shield between danger and your companions, then make enemies regret trying to fight past it. Attacks against nearby allies build force behind your next melee blow, while a sudden shield bash can stop a marked enemy cold with a stun. Between sheltering adjacent allies from incoming fire, reinforcing your own defenses, and answering a missed melee attack with dazing, weakening pressure, you give the party a sturdy place to rally.

paths.title: Shock Trooper
paths.description: Get inside an enemy's guard and stay there, weaving between strikes as you look for a chance to bury another blade. Off-hand weapons hit harder in your grip, and Dexterity eventually rewards attacks made with combat advantage, making careful positioning worth the effort. Your powers can build into a three-hit assault, turn a miss into better footing or protection, and use a free hand to seize an enemy for a vicious close-range strike.

paths.title: Siegebreaker
paths.requirements: One-Handed Weapon Talent or Two-Handed Weapon Talent
paths.description: Bring a two-handed weapon to bear on an exposed enemy and keep pounding until the defense gives way. Combat advantage adds Constitution-driven force to your blows, while repeated at-will hits help line up the next attack and an action point can put extra weight behind a strike that has already landed. As enemies fall, fresh opponents grant you openings, letting you carry the assault onward with dazing blows, bleeding wounds, and punishing knockdowns.

paths.title: Swordmaster
paths.description: Keep a blade fight moving in your favor, turning a critical hit into another use of a spent Fighter encounter attack. Your swordplay carries selected at-will techniques into a charge and gives you a precise strike against Reflex that can punish an opening as an opportunity attack. Defensive bursts help you survive a committed assault, while your great sweeping attack can recover a spent daily power and leave you ready for another decisive exchange.

paths.title: Warhound of Bane
paths.description: Recover your footing and come back harder, turning a spent healing surge into renewed accuracy in melee. You can trade an action point for healing, strike to mend your own wounds, and lean on your shield to strengthen your resolve against attacks on Will. A commanding stance steadies nearby allies while troubling marked enemies until a hit breaks it, and your fiercest assault can bind one foe to your challenge while leaving others easier to bring down.

paths.title: Wrathbearer
paths.description: Fight with a Battlerager's fury, using invigorating attacks to sustain the brawl and turning a missed swing into greater accuracy on the next attack. An action point gives your weapon attacks a sustained surge of force, while a growing reserve of health keeps you in the crush of bodies. Wide, angry blows send enemies sprawling, your stance draws attackers into your marks, and foes felled by your greatest assault risk another strike when they try to stand beside you.
